Steps.Action: Sign in as admin@acmecoffee.com with role BackofficeUser.
Navigate to the customer detail page for the first customer (URL: /customers/{id}, where id is the first customer by DB ID — the one seeded with SocialSecurityNumber "123-45-6789").
Verify the SSN field wrapper element (data-testid="field-ssn-wrapper") is visible on the customer detail page.

Verifications.Text: The SSN field wrapper element (data-testid="field-ssn-wrapper") is visible.

Steps.Action: Verify the masked span (data-testid="restricted-field-masked-Customer-SocialSecurityNumber") is visible and its text starts with "XXX-XX-" (the configured mask format).

Verifications.Text: The masked span (data-testid="restricted-field-masked-Customer-SocialSecurityNumber") is visible.
The masked span text contains "XXX-XX-" (the mask format prefix from the DefaultMaskRule "XXX-XX-{last4}").

Review.ItemLabel: Row expander renders the correlation cluster section
Review.Feedback: Judgment item — Whether the correlation cluster contains sibling rows depends on the Blazor circuit scope at audit-emission time. RoleSwitch and FieldUnmaskedRead share a CorrelationId only when they occur on the same page without an intervening navigation (the RenderCorrelationScope resets on LocationChanged). In the standard UAT flow they occur on separate pages, so the cluster may show "No other rows." The reviewer must judge that the cluster UI renders correctly regardless of sibling count.

Steps.Action: Sign in as admin@acmecoffee.com with role CrossOrgMonitor.
Navigate to /admin/security and click the "Compliance Review" tab.

Verifications.Text: The compliance-review-tab container (data-testid="compliance-review-tab") is visible.

Steps.Action: Wait for the grid to populate with audit event rows.

Verifications.Text: At least one event chip (data-testid contains "event-chip") is visible in the grid.

Steps.Action: Click the first table cell (td) of the first data row — the expand-toggle cell in MudDataGrid.

Verifications.Text: The expand icon button on the first data row is visible before clicking.

Steps.Action: Verify the expander container (data-testid matching "compliance-review-row-*-expander") is visible below the first row.

Verifications.Text: The expander container (data-testid matching "compliance-review-row-*-expander") is visible.

Steps.Action: Verify that either a cluster table (data-testid contains "-cluster-table") or a 'No other rows' caption (data-testid contains "-cluster-empty") is present inside the expander.

Verifications.Text: Either a cluster table (data-testid contains "-cluster-table") is present, or a "No other rows" caption (data-testid contains "-cluster-empty") is present. At least one of the two must render.
